name: Elizabeth Colombo
source: A successful author that has written a considerable amount of supernatural and horror books. Many are seen as odd occult material but that hasn’t stopped them from selling. She’s aloof and doesn’t take kindly to fools… which really makes you wonder why she’s pairing up with William for The Game of Fourtune.
